subject: systems_engineering

resources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
resources.provider: NASA Office of the Chief Engineer
resources.notes: Official NASA systems engineering guidance covering requirements, architecture, design decisions, product realization, integration, life cycles, technical management, and MBSE context.

resources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook - Fundamentals
resources.provider: NASA Office of the Chief Engineer
resources.notes: NASA fundamentals introduce the multidisciplinary SE engine, project phases, cost-effectiveness considerations, verification versus validation, and Human Systems Integration.

resources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook - System Design Processes
resources.provider: NASA Office of the Chief Engineer
resources.notes: Primary NASA guidance for stakeholder expectations, technical requirements, logical decomposition, trade studies and design solution definition.

resources.title: NASA Systems Modeling Handbook for Systems Engineering
resources.notes: Active public NASA handbook integrating SysML-based system modeling with stakeholder, requirements, architecture, verification and validation work products.

resources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook - Appendix and Templates
resources.provider: NASA Office of the Chief Engineer
resources.notes: NASA appendix material includes requirements, verification matrices, reliability and specialty engineering, integration planning, risk considerations, life-cycle planning, and an HSI plan outline.

resources.title: NASA Human Systems Integration Handbook
resources.notes: NASA/SP-20210010952 provides public guidance for integrating humans with hardware, software, data and processes across program and project life cycles.

known_gaps: Foundation-level systems engineering instruction remains thin and should not be inferred from professional NASA handbooks.
Dedicated introductory reliability-engineering and decision-analysis resources should be added in a measured gap-fill pass.
